# Intrepid Parallel, Lda

> Intrepid Parallel, Lda is a software company in Lisbon, Portugal. It makes Windows desktop programs, with interfaces in 16 languages, under the mBrothers brand.

mBrothers is a brand used by Intrepid Parallel, Lda.

## Programs

- [ExplorerFocus](https://intrepidparallel.com/explorerfocus/): a file explorer for Windows 11 and 10, a replacement for Windows Explorer for people who always work in the same folders. Profiles as tabs, a preview that opens almost anything, encrypted vaults compatible with Cryptomator, remote connections (SFTP, FTP, WebDAV, Dropbox, OneDrive) and file tools. Free version with no time limit; PREMIUM adds more. More in [its llms.txt](https://intrepidparallel.com/explorerfocus/llms.txt).
- [The Absolute LogViewer](https://intrepidparallel.com/logviewer/): a free Windows log viewer with live tail, regex highlight rules, split-pane comparison and context preview. More in [its llms.txt](https://intrepidparallel.com/logviewer/llms.txt).
